hook: Told She Had a Week, She Finally Lived

voices.name: l00
voices.text: The doctor told her: <#0.3#> you only have days left.
voices.caption: The doctor told her: you only have days left.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: From that moment, <#0.2#> she started to live for the first time.
voices.caption: From that moment, she started to live for the first time.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: She played piano in the middle of the night, <#0.2#> said what she felt, <#0.2#> and fell in love.
voices.caption: She played piano in the middle of the night, said what she felt, and fell in love.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: The doctor said it on purpose, <#0.2#> so she would finally live.
voices.caption: The doctor said it on purpose, so she would finally live.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Can you start living <#0.3#> before someone tells you that?
voices.caption: Can you start living before someone tells you that?
